objective: Expose the existing bounded DR24 backend capability through a strict multi-OID raw API request, without identity grouping, normalization, feature generation or inference.

previous_knowledge_consumed.detail: The DR24 backend already accepts up to ten unique positive OIDs and preserves per-OID payloads and provenance. The ObservationService and HTTP route exposed only one OID per request.
DR24 objectid identifies a per-filter/field/quadrant time series; HMJD, native photometry and catflags must remain source-native until separately validated.

expected_improvement: Expose bounded multi-OID raw retrieval at the application/API boundary
Reject malformed, duplicate, non-positive and over-limit requests
Preserve raw OID records and missing-OID provenance without cross-OID grouping

correctness.before: The backend supported up to ten OIDs, but the service and HTTP endpoint accepted only one OID per request.
correctness.after: A strict 1–10 OID POST contract, service method and API regression tests have been added; current-head CI is pending.

reliability.before: No multi-OID HTTP request contract existed.
reliability.after: Validation and source-failure contracts are covered by deterministic tests; current-head CI is pending.

scientific_validity.reason: This change is raw acquisition only. It does not approve source identity, time, photometry, QC, features or inference.

measurement.trade_off: Batching reduces request overhead while retaining separate OID records. It does not infer that multiple OIDs belong to one astrophysical source.

evidence: Code and deterministic API tests were added on a branch based on PR #264 head 8948f7af7dbb0a08c3a2454a8703276b6d2630b7.
Current-head CI and source-backed batch parity have not yet run.

Live HATS batch API parity workflow 42350269655 passed on current head 85201bcd121912aa89f7017e0358c74478b4e574: 2 pinned OIDs retrieved through POST /v1/dr24/lightcurves; both epoch counts and payload SHA-256 values matched independent references; requested/returned/missing provenance assertions passed.

root_causes: The service wrapped every DR24 request as a single-element tuple, despite backend support for up to ten OIDs.
The HTTP API exposed only a path parameter for one OID.
unresolved: No physical-source identity or OID grouping rule is implemented.
No approved DR24 time, photometry or quality-selection contract exists.
No DR24 feature mapping or model inference is enabled.

findings: Bounded multi-OID retrieval is an engineering capability, not a source identity decision.
Every returned OID remains a separate source-native record.
Missing OIDs must remain explicit in provenance; no ALeRCE fallback is allowed.

open_blockers: Repeat the live batch parity test across the remaining pinned OIDs and verify source-backed missing-OID behavior; current run covers two OIDs only.
Run current-head CI and inspect every test result.
Keep the batch endpoint raw-only until the scientific contracts are approved.

knowledge_carried_forward: The POST /v1/dr24/lightcurves endpoint accepts 1–10 unique positive integer OIDs.
The endpoint preserves separate raw OID records and missing-OID provenance.
No astrophysical grouping, photometric/time transformation, QC selection, feature generation or inference is performed.
